about: UNVERIFIED (no run on file shows it): a pack behind a closed door that has aggroed the party. Every target/engage veto now runs through ClosedDoorBetween (GameObject-only LOS against the door's real mesh), and the corridor trash scan truncates at the first closed door (memory dc-door-engage-priority, dc-door-los-oracle). Those gates were built to stop the tank fighting through a door it cannot open. Nothing exempts a mob that is already ON the party, so the tank may never engage what holds it. The scenario stages the Scarlet Champion pack inside the SM Chapel (40004/40005, from tr-20260922-193118-33#20, where the door was open) and starts the tank at that pull's real position outside. It shuts the Chapel Door (GO 11875, entry 104591), drops a locked portcullis (18972, not openable by a bot) in the same doorway, and aggroes the pack onto the tank through it.

expect.knownFailure: open:dc-door-engage-priority (ClosedDoorBetween veto has no exemption for a mob already on the party; unconfirmed)
